page.notes: Handwritten annotations in the right margin (e.g. "Bellojou", "Chassanæus", "Bellojon ad Arelatensem & Aquensem", "Senator Senensis ad Bellojonium", and the marginal comment beside "Male") are manuscript marks, not printed text, and are not transcribed. Underlining in the text (e.g. "Male", "Superfedeamus", "heus tu domine Arelatensis") is hand-drawn, not printed. The left edge of the scan is cut, so the first letters of "onfiterer", "oci", "ocius" and "oiocius" are damaged; the fragments are given as far as legible. "facianus" in the last line is as printed (possibly for "faciamus"), not corrected. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed and the word joined.
